email.subject: Quick fix for Forge Fitness's site
email.body:
Hi Ravi,

I took a look at Forge Fitness's website. Two things are likely costing you members: there's no way to book a class online, so people have to call or walk in during business hours, and there's no click-to-call link on mobile, so visitors searching on their phone can't tap to reach you. Both push interested people to just try another gym instead.

I fix issues like this for a flat fee. Want a free 10-minute walkthrough where I show you exactly what's happening and how to fix it? No obligation either way.

Alex
Northlight Web
